title: 7 Years Later, Attack on Titan Director Opens Up About MAPPA’s Takeover
content: WIT Studio was established in 2012, and the very first anime produced by the studio was Attack on Titan . Based on the award-winning manga written and illustrated by Hajime Isayama, the anime debuted in 2013 and didn’t take long before capturing viewers’ attention.

title: Firefly Wedding Manga Gets Live-Action Adaptation on TV in 2027
content: The official website for the television anime of Oreko Tachibana 's Firefly Wedding ( Hotaru no Yomeiri ) manga announced on Saturday that the manga is getting a live-action adaptation on Fuji TV in 2027. The website streamed a video, but it is not available in the U.S.

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Just Confirmed Two More Seasons
content: Today marks the first time in twelve years that a new animated TV series in the Avatar: The Last Airbender franchise has arrived, as the first three episodes of Avatar: Seven Havens have officially arrived on Paramount+.

title: Manga 'Hotaru no Yomeiri' Gets Live-Action Adaptation in 2027
content: Television broadcast company Fuji TV announced a live-action adaptation of Oreco Tachibana 's Hotaru no Yomeiri ( Firefly Wedding ) web manga on Saturday, revealing an announcement promotional video. The live-action series is scheduled to premiere on Fuji TV in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Casshern R Manga Listed as Ending With 3rd Volume
content: Retailers are listing the third compiled book volume of Satoshi Shiki 's Casshern R manga — the adaptation of Tatsunoko Production 's Shinzō Ningen Casshan original television anime — as the final volume. The volume will ship on December 18.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Highly Anticipated Ghost of Tsushima Anime Gets Bad News
content: Earlier this year, at a press conference held by Crunchyroll , it was announced that Sucker Punch’s Ghost of Tsushima video game would receive a new anime adaptation titled Ghost of Tsushima: Legends . It was exciting news, and fans were thrilled to see another video game franchise receive an expanded vision.

title: WEBTOON to Launch New Marvel Comics App in November
content: WEBTOON Entertainment announced on October 5 it is partnering with Marvel to launch a new Marvel Comics app on November 16, offering digital access to Marvel's library of current and classic comics.
